kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-tags --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOC0000 --proxy-id API --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --tags '“key1”:”value1”' --resource-type INSTANCE --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTags

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the proxy mode
parameters.name: proxy_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

If you specify this parameter, all tags that are added to this instance are queried, and other filter conditions becomes invalid
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。可通过DescribeDBInstances接口查询获取。
如果传入该参数，则查询该实例下所有标签，其他过滤条件失效
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The tag that you want to query. The value of the parameter consists of TagKey and TagValue. Format: `{"TagKey":"TagValue"}`
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的标签，包括TagKey和TagValue。
参数格式：`{“TagKey”:”TagValue”}`
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The type of resource. Set the value to INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type
